purpose: Prove that cart/preorder state remains non-binding and only a verified authorized checkout command can create a purchase obligation.

invariants.proof: checkout depends on verified accepted command semantics rather than UI/cart state
cart is non-binding and does not silently become committed demand
purchase obligation is created only through verified authorized checkout
completed cart cannot be checked out twice; demand authorization consumption remains one-time
cart state is explicitly non-canonical/non-binding and does not redefine obligation semantics
